findings.source_quote: ταῖς τῶν πεπλανημένων εὐποιίαις αἱ τῶν ἀλήθειαν ἐγνωκότων ἰσάζονται πράξεις
findings.english_quote: the actions of those who have known the truth are indeed measured against the good deeds of those who have been deceived
findings.issue: “Measured against” expresses comparison without explicitly retaining the equality or equal-footing force of ἰσάζονται. That force matters to the argument and its subsequent repeated contrast between equal good and doing more.
findings.suggested_revision: Replace “are indeed measured against” with “are indeed placed on an equal footing with.” This proposed wording preserves the equality language without deciding that every action necessarily receives an identical valuation; it requires fresh review in the complete sentence.

findings.source_quote: Μαρόνην τὸν ἀποδεξάμενον αὐτόν, ἤδη λοιπὸν τέλειον ὄντα
findings.english_quote: Maron, who had received him and was by now mature
findings.issue: “Mature” is a defensible contextual rendering of τέλειον, but its significant status ambiguity is not disclosed. Besides spiritual or moral maturity, “complete” or “perfected,” potentially referring to completed initiation in this baptismal context, is a material alternative. The draft's notes do not explain why maturity is selected.
findings.suggested_revision: Add a lexical note quoting “ἤδη λοιπὸν τέλειον ὄντα,” explaining the contextual maturity reading and preserving “now complete/perfected,” potentially “fully initiated,” as an alternative. Do not present initiation as an explicit or uniquely established meaning. The main rendering need not be rejected merely because these alternatives exist; the revised disclosure must undergo fresh review.
